jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer (Bilbao or San Sebastian)
jobs_results.description:
This position offers you the opportunity to join a fast-growing technology organization that is pushing productivity paradigms in the software engineering industry. If you are passionate about technology and want to learn about new trends that are shaping human behavior, this opportunity is for you.

As a Senior Engineer at Vicomtech, you'll focus on software delivery, containers, telemetry and orchestration (scaling and migration). You will scale our DevOps team in the field of virtualized 5G/6G networks and multimedia services in Linux environments to new heights. You'll charge on premise services automating infrastructure provisioning, and ensuring the stability and performance of our applications to satisfy dynamic and concurrent trade-offs. Collaborating in our research teams, you'll integrate DevOps solutions and best practises, driving efficiency and innovation across the organisation.

The impact you'll make:

· You’ll be part of an enthusiastic, knowledgeable, and above all... passionate team. We would like you to display these same attributes and display proven knowledge about cloud and automation, systems administration, infrastructure management.

· You'll thrive when working on problems from identification to resolution and looking to solve any recurring tasks or issues through automation.

· You’re comfortable working in different projects and teams.

· You have well-thought-out opinions about how technologies and toolsets can be used to create elegant solutions and are happy sharing these.

· You care about the quality and integrity of the outputs from your team and want to work with people who care.

Technology stack:

· Linux systems

· Kubernetes (on-premise and AWS EKS)

· Docker, Ansible

· Python, REST API

· GitLab, GitHub toolset

· Monitoring (Prometheus, Grafana, Kibana)

· IoT Messaging, Kafka (desired)

· Workflow engines (desired)

What you'll bring to us:

· 3+ years of experience with DevOps and with the cloud.

· Expertise in Kubernetes (AWS and EKS solutions optional).

· Expertise developing and integration.

· Expertise in monitoring and alerting.

· Expertise building data pipelines in the cloud (optional).

· Understanding of optimisation techniques.

· Strong understanding of scalable distributed systems and microservices architecture, with the ability to design and implement solutions that meet performance and scalability requirements.

· Ability to translate product requirements into proposed technical solutions.

· Independent work ownership & delivery of relevant tasks.

· Communicative, visible & collaborative (cross-technical teams & wider), including providing clear updates and mentoring peers.

· Understanding of wider product development, impact of engineering tasks on progress, and interdependencies across the team.

· Focus on clear, effective documentation of technical work.

· Results-orientation, with motivation for the success of the entire team and project versus one’s individual tasks.

· Written and verbal English communication skills.

Bonus points if you have:

· Contribution to open source projects.

· Experience with GPU/CUDA virtualization.

· Experience with OpenStack.

· C/C++ development proficiency.

· SQL data storage experience.

· Scientific publications.

· PhD.

If you are a creative, proactive, responsible, methodical and decisive person, with the capacity for teamwork and adaptation to new complex projects, communication skills, impact analysis and negotiation. If you are interested in applied research and transferring the technology you develop to society.

What will you do:

· Develop applied research activities in projects according to your specialization.

· You will carry out continuous surveillance on the state of the art in relation to the Virtualization and DevOps Technologies market and Open Source tools.

· You will contribute to the generation of new ideas and concepts of technological development and identify new business opportunities in the area of interest.

· You will contribute to the preparation of applied research and development proposals for national and international companies, as well as European proposals.

· Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement robust, scalable, and efficient systems that meet the demands in and beyond the state of the art.

· As a result of your research activity, you will carry out tasks aimed at scientific production, such as publishing indexed articles or directing doctoral theses.

· Stay ahead of industry trends and emerging technologies, constantly researching and experimenting with innovative solutions to enhance our observability platform.

· Be proactive in identifying and addressing performance bottlenecks, applying optimizations, and maintaining the stability and availability of our platform.

· Encourage a culture of continuous learning, improvement, and innovation within the engineering team, sharing knowledge and promoting professional growth.

What we offer you:

· Be part of a growing Applied Research Center.

· Join a growing team with great projection in the subject, a pioneer in Virtualized Technologies at the core of 5G/6G networks and Multimedia services, in a multicultural, multidisciplinary, multi-vertical, dynamic and enriching work environment.

· Participate in cutting-edge collaborative projects in the fields of 5G/6G and video streaming, both national and international, expanding your network of relationships and personal contacts.

· Enjoy professional development opportunities, participating in leading projects through which to respond to the challenges of the future and being able to pursue a solid professional career.

· Integrate into a continuous training process in the technologies of your interest.

· Collaborate with high-level regional, national and international research groups.

· Work-life balance policies to achieve a balance between work and family life

Get ahead with Prosoz!

We support local authorities throughout Germany on their journeyinto the digital future.

As a full-service provider, wedeliver solutions from a single source - from software toconsulting.

To drive forward the digital transformationin municipal administration, we are looking for you as a

DevOps (m / f / d)

Join our full-time team in the Social Security businessunit in Herten in the heart of the Ruhr area - and get ahead withthe market leader for municipal IT solutions!

This will be your job...
• We workwith a challenging tech stack and involve you in the topic ofoperations in an agile process right from the development stage
• You take care of the build process as wellas the support and technical advice of the developers
• Your team's CI / CD pipeline automates as many developmentprocesses as... possible
• You and the team takecare of providing the infrastructure for the product (DMS,monitoring, logging, databases, etc.)
• Youmaintain contact with suppliers, data centers and municipaloperators

This is what wewant...
• You have a degree in(business) informatics or a comparable qualification
• You already have several years of professionalexperience in the operation of distributed software
• Ideally, you have in-depth knowledge of Linux and Dockerand all the other things you need : Git, Jenkins etc.
• Ideally, you also have a good pinch of containermanagement know-how (Kubernetes, OpenShift, etc.)
• You have initial knowledge of IT security andmonitoring, alerting, etc.
• Above all : anawareness that your knowledge has a relatively short half-life andthat you need to constantly refresh your knowledge

You might think so...

You fit in with us if the following sentences could also come fromyou :
• I'm looking for theopportunity to really do the agile stuff for once.
• For me, DevOps is a mindset and not something you cansprinkle over a job.
• I work with the devsand talk to them, not about them.
• I can alsolook at the situation through the eyes of the devs and activelymake suggestions.
• I also think outside thebox to find the best solutions.

Good reasons for PROSOZ...
• Highlevel of personal responsibility and short decision-making paths
• Appreciative and open cooperation at eyelevel and a strong feedback culture
• Plentyof room to try things out and for your professional and personaldevelopment
• Flexible working hours andmodels that fully support your work-life balance
• Mobile working possible
• Permanentemployment contract and at least 30 days vacation
• Attractive remuneration package and numerous greatbenefits

Do you haveany questions?

Your personal contact is Ginafrom our recruiting team :

Gina Vertgewall Personnel Management Tel. 02366 188 616

We lookforward to hearing from you - you can get in touch with us in justa few clicks!

For reasons ofreadability alone, we refrain from using gender-specificdifferentiation in our texts. We always refer to allgenders

jobs_results.description: Cloud Computing, Digitalisierung, WAN, Linux, VMware, Telefonanlagen, TLS, IT, DevOps, 3rd-Level-Support, Cisco WebEx, VoIP, Cisco, LAN Devops Cloud Engineer (Voice) (m/f/d) Reference number: PLN TDBO-YF DevOps Cloud Engineer (Voice) (m/f/d) (Germany-wide) Permanent employee, Full-time - Cologne, Remote DEAR FUTURE COLLEAGUE, Today we are applying to you again and introducing you to our company, our services and what makes Plusnet special: WE LIVE AND CREATE COMMUNICATION As a leading telecommunications company with more than 28,000 business customers, we are bringing Germany as a business location into the age of gigaspeed internet. Many companies, large and small, are unsettled and challenged by digitalization. With our products and solutions in the areas of internet, telephony and networking, we help them to position themselves successfully for the future. Our fiber optic expansion and network services also make us an important partner for local authorities and municipal utilities... Together, we are working on Germany's future viability and making our contribution to sustainable economic and social development in the country. You can help shape and advance these important topics. YOUR HOME ZONE WITH US Business IT develops and operates applications that support the customer journey so that our customers always receive the best possible support. This is done in four teams: IT Delivery Management, BSS Development, OSS Development and the DevOps team with a focus on infrastructure and cloud engineering. YOUR FIELD OF ACTIVITY As a DevOps Cloud Engineer (Voice) (m/f/d) (Germany-wide), you will make an important contribution to Plusnet's business success. Exciting and diverse tasks await you in your field of work: Responsible for the technical design and further development of the Plusnet Cloud PBX Voice platforms Tengo-Centraflex and Combase Technical contact person for the system supplier Cisco-Broadworks or Webex and various end device and client manufacturers e.g. Yealink, Aastra/Mitel, Cisco, ESTOS Technical processing of customer tenders and technical management in TC customer projects Specification and development of process and operating instructions for the support instances Technical support for error analyses in 3rd level support WHAT YOU BRING WITH YOU Completed vocational training or studies in the field of telecommunications Several years of relevant professional experience in designing, setting up and operating VolP-based telecommunications system solutions, ideally with Cisco Broadworks Very in-depth knowledge of SIP-based voice switching with practical experience of corresponding system components Very good knowledge and practical experience in the areas of LAN/WAN, TCP/TLS, Linux, VMWare Very good written and spoken German and English skills Independent and autonomous way of working with a structured and methodical approach Strong learning ability, commitment, ability to work in a team and perseverance Very good analytical skills and flexible in dealing with problems and new requirements Strong communication skills in customer contact WHAT WE OFFER YOU Plusnet is a company with an established culture - something we are proud of. Integrating you well into our team and ensuring that you can tackle your tasks with expertise, commitment and fulfillment is a matter close to our hearts. We offer you numerous benefits: Work-life balance Modern working model with flexible trust-based working hours Work from home or on the road - five days a week if you like Support from the Plusnet family service Further development Career path with three development directions (management / specialist / project work) Individual training and development opportunities Corporate culture We are all on a first-name basis and casual at work Open, collegial, informal working environment Company events such as summer parties, Christmas parties etc. Barrier-free premises Other services Employer-financed insurance benefits such as company pension scheme and private accident insurance Free internet and VoIP connection at home Free parking spaces "Employees recruit employees" bonus program Subsidy for glasses for a computer workstation Employee fitness at the Urban Sports Club and much more Want to shape the digital future with us? Then apply now. Simply apply online and without a cover letter. Reference number: PLN TDBO-YF. If you have any questions, the recruiting team will be happy to help you at any time: recruiting[AT]plusnet.de We welcome everyone, regardless of gender, age, sexual identity, origin, religion, ideology, with or without a disability. The main thing is that they fit in with us. Our information on data protection for applicants (f/m/d). Do you have any questions? Go ahead, get in touch! jobs_results.title: Product DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Flowable is the leading provider of open-source Intelligent Business Automation solutions that combine the power of Case, Process and Decision support into a single platform.

Used by many of the world’s leading organizations like SAP, Dow Jones and other Fortune-500 companies, Flowable provides world-class Intelligent Automation solutions with a strong emphasis on human-centric workflow.

This is an ideal position for an ambitious and open-minded DevOps Engineer, who would like to make a significant impact on our recent company Cloud strategy while working with a modern product.
What you will be doing:

Contribute to our cloud offering – Within the Product Team and aligned with our market SaaS strategy, participate in the planning, prioritization and execution of new Flowable cloud functionalities

Technology innovation – Continuously improve on the tools and frameworks used in the Flowable cloud environment including Helm charts, ArgoCD, Terraform and Grafana.

Security assurance –... Identify security risks in the environment, tools and frameworks used in the Flowable cloud environment and ensure that any security issues are solved in a timely manner.

Maintenance – Monitor the Flowable cloud environment using insightful dashboards and triggers for exceptional cases.
What you bring:

Do you have a flexible, hands-on attitude, a problem-solving mentality and like to communicate in an open, constructive way? If this sounds like you, then take a look at our technical requirements:

At least 3 years' experience in a similar DevOps role within a Java-based context.

Experience with running enterprise applications on Azure and AWS on an Oracle or Postgres database.

Big plus if you have experience with Terraform, ArgoCD, Prometheus and/or Grafana.

Big plus if you bring SaaS-related experience.

Fluent English (working environment mostly in English).
What you can expect:

You will enjoy flexible working hours, training, and home-office possibilities. However, we think these are the most interesting advantages of working at Flowable:

Significant impact – As our Product DevOps Engineer you will have the opportunity to help shape our strategic Cloud offering and therefore significantly contribute to the future success of Flowable

Great Product – Work for the product company with the most innovative Process Automation Platform, recognized by customers and loved by a big community of software engineers around the world!

Modern technologies – Enjoy using a modern tech-stack and implement new, innovative cloud tools and technologies within our SaaS offering.

If this describes you and your aspirations, please click on the apply button to embark on a new and successful adventure!

If this describes you and your aspirations, please click on the APPLY button below to embark on a new and successful adventure! Apply Now!
#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Ingeniero/A Devops Senior (Inglés Alto) (Teletrabajo)
jobs_results.description:
Únete a nuestro equipo En ACCUDE TI buscamos profesional DevOps con, al menos, 4 años de experiencia y nivel alto de inglés para integrarse en proyecto en modalidad remota. Requisitos técnicos:
• Experiencia en diseño y construcción de pipelines CI/CD de aplicaciones e infraestructura, que incluyan proceso de integración continua y análisis de vulnerabilidades.
• Herramientas de orquestación, preferiblemente GitLab, CICD, y ArgoCD.
• Conocimientos demostrables del ecosistema de herramientas DevOps (orquestadores, gestión, configuración, monitorización, logging, automatización de pruebas funcionales y de rendimiento, calidad, etc.).
• Experiencia en Kubernetes.
• Experiencia en OpenShift.
• Experiencia con herramientas de gestión de artefactos binarios, preferiblemente Artifactory o Nexus.
• Conocimiento de sistemas de monitorización y gestión centralizada de logs. * Nivel alto de inglés * Titulación académica: Grado en Informática o carreras técnicas. Requisitos valorables:
•... Experiencia con ElasticSearch (ELK). Ref: M3530 Ofrecemos: Plan de Carrera Profesional Plan de Formación y Subvención de Certificaciones Técnicas Buen Ambiente de Trabajo ACCUDE TI somos una compañía de servicios tecnológicos comprometida con nuestro activo más preciado: las PERSONAS. Apostamos por el desarrollo de nuestro equipo, para que su talento aporte el éxito a cada uno de nuestros proyectos. Finalidad: Mantenimiento de la comunicación entre ambas partes, resolución de dudas y consultas planteadas, participación en procesos de selección y facilitar el acceso a nuestros clientes y contactos la información referente a nuestros servicios. jobs_results.title: Autonomous Database Engineer (Cloud DBA & DevOps)
jobs_results.description:
The Autonomous Database Team is responsible for building the Cloud service framework powering various Oracle Autonomous Database cloud services, including Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW) and Autonomous Transaction Processing (ATP).

The framework automates deployment, scaling and management of databases in the cloud. It is built on top of Oracle's Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Layer.

The Autonomous Database cloud service framework features APIs to handle all lifecycle management operations of databases.

It also performs operations autonomously based on internal and external events. The team has the unique opportunity to make significant contributions to the full stack of Oracle technology, from database kernel to cloud service platform and to customer-facing portals.

You will be responsible for deploying fixes for the Autonomous Database service with a deep focus on architecture, production operations, performance management, deployment and release engineering.

You will work with... multiple cross-functional teams helping deliver new and outstanding experiences to our stakeholders while ensuring reliability and performance.

The successful candidate will be expected to interface with both senior management and the various delivery teams across OCI and database security and compliance architecture team to define and maintain our compliance posture in an environment of increasing regulatory expectations and growth.

We are a dynamic and enthusiastic team with great emphasis on go-getters and proactive individuals.

Overview from with links to other collateral :

In this role you will need to :
• Operate and performs maintenance to cloud database services running within the region.
• Assess, prioritize, and communicate risks and urgency to leadership and engineering teams
• Take ownership of the implementation and production operations of a wide array of core system platform solutions
• React to production deficiencies by continuously implementing automation, self-healing, and real-time monitoring to production systems
• Ensure thorough documentation of incidents through company-standard reporting methods.
• Stay informed of cloud infrastructure stacks

Preferred Qualifications :
• At least a Bachelor’s degree, in Computer Science, MIS or another technical field, or equivalent work experience.
• Solid experience with Linux.
• Experience troubleshooting complex software and / or networking issues.
• Knowledge on Cloud computing architecture, primarily Identity, Compute and Networking
• Expert level experience, understanding, implementation and troubleshooting of Oracle Database technology including RAC, Dataguard, ASM, RMAN preferred.
• Development skills utilizing Python, shell, SQL, Terraform
• Prior DevOps or continuous delivery and deployment experience preferred
• Strong communication and analytical skills
• Proven ability to quickly learn new technical domains and then train others.

Career Level - IC3

jobs_results.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
If you want to work with incredible professionals and you love new challenges, this is the place for you!

Being an Intelygenz DevOps means you’ve been singled out for your capabilities and skills in automation, definition, and standardization. Our DevOps help other developers achieve greater efficiency and quality in their working processes using the most cutting-edge tools.

Given their key role in strategy, the DevOps team cannot allow workarounds, and their work must always be held to the highest of standards. This is why they all have many years of experience and learning with them as mentors, becomes a professionally enriching experience.

During your first month, you will be lucky enough to have at least one expert mentor walk you through this phase and help get you oriented and on your way to success. From the second month onwards, you will be in control and able to make decisions that you consider appropriate and necessary for every situation that arises.

Skills
• At least 4... years experience in a similar position.
• Thorough knowledge in:
• Management and deployment using AWS.
• Deployment infrastructure as code using Terraform.
• Git version control.
• Linux/Unix operating systems, both physical and virtualized infrastructures.
• Knowledge in:
• Container deployment architectures (Docker, Kubernetes, Openshift, EKS, ECS).
• Configuration management systems like Ansible, Puppet, Chef, SaltStack, etc.
• Basic administration of databases (MySQL, MongoDB, PostgreSQL).
• Experience configuring a system of CI/CD (GitLabCI, Jenkins, Bamboo, etc.
• Ability to develop scripts in at least one programming language (Python or Ruby type)
• Experience in agile projects and methodologies
• For this position, it is essential to have an upper-intermediate to advanced level of English and Spanish in reading, speaking, and writing.

Bonus Points
• Management and deployment using GCP, OpenStack, Azure, etc.
• Different software testing strategies.
• Have been involved in designing a cloud-based solution.
• Ability to drop into code and logs to diagnose problems.
• Experience with good development practices.
• Ability to work closely with the team, ensuring the creation of accessible, high-performance applications.
• Excellent level of oral and written communication with customers, both internal and external.
• Must be autonomous and have a clear focus on customer/service/results.
• Excellent problem-solving ability, high level of initiative, responsibility, adaptation, highly motivated and eager to learn.

Why Intelygenz?
• Flexible schedule and 100% freedom to work from anywhere you’d like - from your home, our office, or even from a tropical island!
• Specific career plans for horizontal and vertical growth plus mentoring to help you grow in your career. Let your motivations do the talking!
• Tech programs: continuous training (1 hour per week to learn with your co-workers)
• English classes, paid events, Udemy courses and one hour per week to take part in continuous tech training programs with your co-workers. Sky is the limit!!
• Courses and certifications granted (AWS, Google Cloud…)
• Open bar of Udemy
• Don't be afraid of you you are! You will feel embraced and supported by the team and the whole company.
• Office in Callao area, one of the coolest in Madrid
• Events in and outside Madrid (tickets + transport + accommodation, even outside Europe)
• Flexible retribution: restaurant, transport and kindergarten
• Health insurance (50% granted)
• Gympass and football, basketball, paddle and runners team
• Parties and team building events
• Being part of this great team!
• ... and an Intelygenz Anniversary exclusive T-Shirt
